scope: S10 fast handoff / selected reference card gate only
contract_changes: Bottom partial/incomplete S10 cards are informational normal scroll-list state and no longer hard-block S10 handoff.
target_partial_card_only is no longer emitted as a strong error signal.
Handoff now gates only the selected_reference_card: fully visible, fields complete, clickable, and safe click area.
If selected_reference_card itself is partial, block with SELECTED_REFERENCE_CARD_NOT_FULLY_VISIBLE.
If selected_reference_card is fully visible but missing required fields, block with REFERENCE_CARD_INCOMPLETE_AFTER_SCROLL.
Partial bottom cards remain excluded from canonical_reference_order and cannot become selected cards.
